description: A device target's qubits, pairs, native gates with the spread of their errors and durations, its calibration snapshot and its hash; with view, each qubit's place for drawing its coupling map with its readout and one-qubit errors, and each pair's two-qubit error. Give a built-in target's name or a target document.

target.description: A built-in target's name, or a target document.

name: show_target

anyOf.description: A device target in brief: its name and hash, where it came from, its calibration snapshot, its qubits and pairs, each native gate's error and duration across the device, the native gate set it is compiled to, and its qubits' T1, T2 and readout error.

document.description: A device target: its qubits, the pairs it couples, its native gates with their errors and durations, and the calibration snapshot they come from. A value not known is left out, never written as zero. Every field but format, name, source, qubits, gates and coupling is optional, and a field the format does not name is refused, so a misspelt one never reads as absent. Its canonical text is its RFC 8785 form, and the BLAKE3 of that text, the target's hash, names the snapshot in a receipt.

id.description: The calibration snapshot's id, as the source names it, or a content id of the snapshot read.

timestamp.description: When the snapshot was taken, as the source writes it.

coupling.description: The pairs a two-qubit gate may act on, each once, the lower qubit first, sorted.

gates.description: Each native gate where the device runs it, sorted by gate then qubits.

label.description: The source's own name for it, when that is not its index.

qubit.description: Its index: its place in the list.

t2_us.description: T2 (the echo or Ramsey time the source reports), microseconds.

format.description: The format the target was read from (wai-quantum targets import --help lists them).

document.title: wai.quantum.target/1

duration_ns.description: The least, the median and the most of a figure across the device, and how many it has; null when the target gives none.

error.description: The least, the median and the most of a figure across the device, and how many it has; null when the target gives none.

hash.description: BLAKE3 of the target document's RFC 8785 text: what a receipt names.

native.description: The compiler's gate set the target's gates hold, whether exactly, and how each is costed.

readout_error.description: The least, the median and the most of a figure across the device, and how many it has; null when the target gives none.

t1_us.description: The least, the median and the most of a figure across the device, and how many it has; null when the target gives none.

t2_us.description: The least, the median and the most of a figure across the device, and how many it has; null when the target gives none.

view.description: With view: each qubit's place and errors and each pair's error, to draw the coupling map.

anyOf.description: A refusal as data: the message, every code in it (the last is the code), its outcome and meaning as the code's table gives them. A host that refuses for its own reasons gives the error alone.

outputSchema.description: A device target in brief: its name and hash, where it came from, its calibration snapshot, its qubits and pairs, each native gate's error and duration across the device, the native gate set it is compiled to, and its qubits' T1, T2 and readout error.
